paragraphs.text: Camellia is a legendary squirrelfolk Warlock from Bloomburrow .

Camellia is the one squirrelfolk whose name strikes fear into every baker and farmer in Valley . She has developed a near monopoly on the seeds in Valley, hoarding most of them until the first sign of snow or famine. She has good intentions, though her methods are a bit too extreme for most. Valley has never wanted food since she first loaded her caches with seeds during the seasons of plenty. She knows better than any the cruelty of nature and the gnawing hunger of famine, having grown up in the Brambles where resources were scarce and community scarcer.

Camellia's fur is a soft gray and serves as a backdrop for the intricate robe she wears, crafted from withered maple and willow leaves. The robe is adorned with an array of bird skulls and rib bones. Her bushy tail, a hallmark of her Squirrelfolk heritage, protrudes from the robe and is similarly decorated with small bones, clinking softly with her every movement. Her visage is obscured by a mask made from the carapace of a grasshopper's head.
